title: BOP Antifreeze
description: I've replaced Frank's blood with ethylene glycol. Because it's SCIENCE, that's why!
body: My kids really don't like the Visceral Heap in Biomes O Plenty. BOP lets you disable it from generating in the configs, and Item Obliterator allows you to remove the blocks and items from the creative menu, but I can't get Blood, the fluid, to stop appearing in Just Enough Items. This resource pack changes the colour of blood to green, and renames it as "Antifreeze." I must have messed something up though, because now neither blood nor antifreeze appear in JEI for me. Close enough.
